todos.content: Read component rules: db.md, backend.md, admin.md, storefront.md, webhooks.md, cron.md
Write scaffold/app.json — spine: database, shopifyIntegration, httpRoutes
implements: type-level spine for all contracts above
do_not: declare app_config table (template-managed)
redeclare template-shipped tables

implements: type-level spine for all contracts above
consumes: every externalContract requestShape + responseShape (define an aliased type per endpoint)
every trigger payload (define a typed shape per topic)
every persistence table (define a Row type)
for routes that augment rows with resolved data, define a <Row>WithLive shape that includes the resolved live.<field>
produces: named, branded id types where the plan implies an id (avoid raw string)
exported types every route + UI file imports — no cross-file structural typing
do_not: use `any` for any field the plan typed
let UI files import from route files or vice versa — contracts.ts is the only shared shape

implements: inventory level for a variant changes
a product is deleted from the store
consumes: [inventory_levels/update] event: inventory level for a variant changes
'variant external id' ← resolve variant from inventory_item_id via the admin inventoryItem query (inventoryItem.variant.id)
'product external id' ← resolve product from inventory_item_id via the admin inventoryItem query (inventoryItem.variant.product.id)
[products/delete] event: a product is deleted from the store
produces: idempotent DB writes per the capability each trigger drives
ON CONFLICT on every dedup-keyed insert (per persistence keyedBy)
do_not: early-return when a declared signalField is empty (silently disables the trigger)
read an undeclared payload field (paths above are the contract)
ignore a declared payloadBinding — every signalField above must be read at least once

produces: GET /admin/dashboard responseShape: items, next_cursor, overall_metrics, total_count
GET /admin/settings responseShape: notification_body_template, notification_subject_template, quiet_hours_end, quiet_hours_start, timezone
[resolve-variant-from-inventory-item/inventoryItem] produces: variant external id and product external id
do_not: pass a literal/placeholder GID (e.g. 'gid://shopify/Product/0') to any Shopify op — fail-fast instead
call a bound op only to discard its returned id — every produces above must be persisted or threaded forward
provision Shopify side-effects outside the DB transaction without a rollback path

consumes: POST /widget/signup requestShape: email, item_display_name, item_page_url, product_id, signup_level, variant_id
produces: [check-item-availability/product] produces: variant availableForSale flag and selectedOptions
for every member/row this route returns: include resolved `live.<field>` for any reference the storefront will pass to cartCreate
do_not: fall back from a resolved live.<field> to the raw DB column it shadows (e.g. `?? member.product_external_id`)
accept caller-supplied ids without validating shape (variant ids are numeric strings; merchandise GIDs go to ProductVariant, not Product)

consumes: notification_batches rows in pending status with scheduled_send_at passed
waitlist_entries for batch ordered by signed_up_at ascending
produces: emails sent via platform email helper
do_not: send emails outside the quiet hours window
send to already-notified entries

consumes: calls GET /admin/dashboard — responseShape: items, next_cursor, overall_metrics, total_count
calls GET /admin/subscribers — responseShape: next_cursor, subscribers, total_count
calls GET /admin/subscribers/export — responseShape: csv_data, next_cursor, total_count
calls GET /admin/settings — responseShape: notification_body_template, notification_subject_template, quiet_hours_end, quiet_hours_start, timezone
calls PUT /admin/settings/template — responseShape: preview_body, preview_subject, success
produces: sends GET /admin/subscribers — requestShape: cursor, product_id, variant_id
sends GET /admin/subscribers/export — requestShape: cursor, product_id, variant_id
sends PUT /admin/settings/quiet-hours — requestShape: quiet_hours_end, quiet_hours_start, timezone
do_not: send a placeholder/sentinel (e.g. '0', '', null) for a reference column the plan declares NOT NULL — use real picker data
omit a UI affordance for a nullable-with-purpose column above (the merchant has no other way to set it)
store a variant id where a product id is required (or vice versa)

consumes: for ANY response field shaped `live.<field>` or a resolved id, USE that field for selection / cart / submit — never the raw DB column it shadows
produces: sends GET /widget/signup-status — requestShape: email, product_id, variant_id
sends POST /widget/signup — requestShape: email, item_display_name, item_page_url, product_id, signup_level, variant_id
do_not: use `member.variant_external_id ?? member.product_external_id` (or any analogue) — a product id wrapped as a variant GID breaks cartCreate
build a `gid://shopify/ProductVariant/<id>` from anything that wasn't returned by the backend as a variant id
enable a CTA whose preconditions (selection count, availability) the plan declares — the backend re-validates anyway, but the UI must mirror it
